item.title: Land Rover Defender Breaks Down in a Game Reserve
item.description: A Land Rover Defender encounters mechanical trouble while traveling through a wildlife reserve. Follow the challenges of dealing with a vehicle breakdown in a remote environment and the efforts to get the journey back on track.
